note_prev: This is card #0, the genesis of the root-of-trust tier. There is no predecessor; prev is null by construction, never omitted.
note_created_at: ISO-8601 UTC, set during the ceremony, e.g. 2026-09-12T14:05:00Z.

root_alpha.role: offline root key; signs ONLY genesis card #0 and future ROOT-beta rotation attestations; never signs measurement cards

holders: ROLE: offline backup custodian (separate physical location)
custody.note_holders: Holders are identified by ROLE, not name. Names are written on the physical custody record kept with each share, never in this public card.

root_beta.role: operational signing key, attested by ROOT-alpha via this card; signs operational anchors after the ceremony

scope: Anchors and attestation of operational keys only. This card is never a certification. Measurement cards (card-v1 under the public root) remain the only measured surface; nothing in this genesis tier grades, ranks, certifies, or endorses anything.
note_sig: Created only by scripts/ceremony/genesis_card.py finalize after a matching independent Shamir cross-check record. The tool strips every note_* field, fills identities, canonicalizes the card with sig_ed25519 removed, signs, verifies from root_alpha.pubkey_raw_hex, fsyncs, and atomically creates the destination.
